🍞 Could you live alone in a mountain village where the bread van is your only visitor all week?
This Bulgaria documentary meets the people who stayed while the country lost nearly a third of its population 🇧🇬, and a village that still walks barefoot on fire 🔥
👉 Stay in the village or move to the city with family?Reply A (village) or B (city) below 👇 and subscribe for more real-life stories.
